goal: Enforce requested transaction weight limits when preset inputs already cover the funded amount
Prevents wallet callers from receiving transactions that exceed their specified maximum weight
agreement: Verified by testing reproduction of the fix (jcastros)
Open question whether to also enforce TRUC limits on preset inputs or wait for follow-up (jcastros)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an edge case where wallet funding ignores caller weight limits
Affects callers using max_tx_weight when provided inputs already cover the target value
